question: In which of the following years did Vodafone start its journey in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2007**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vodafone entered the Indian market in the year 2007**.
 
• Vodafone acquired a **67% stake** in Hutchison Essar, one of the leading telecom operators in India, in **2007**.
 
• This acquisition marked Vodafone's official entry into the Indian telecommunications market. *Hence, 2007 is the correct answer.*
 
• The acquisition deal was worth **11.1 billion USD**, making it one of the biggest international investments in India at the time.
